The '''Neural Shock Disruptor''' was a type of [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]] produced by [[Wynz-Tek/Legends|Wynz-Tek]]. During the [[battle for the Black Hole]], the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal [[Kovic]] used a variety of Wynz-Tek grenades, including Neural Shock Disruptors, in battle.
